lines: # Fill this in before anything gets built. Ten minutes.
## What
One sentence. If it needs two, it is two features.
## Who asked
A named person, and the moment they hit the problem.
If this line is empty, the feature is for me. It waits.
## Done looks like
The screen, the number or the message that person sees.
Never "it works".
## Smallest version
What ships if we only have one hour.
## Do not touch
The files, routes and data that stay exactly as they are.
## Before it ships
- the build is green
- opened on a phone, not just a laptop
- the person who asked has seen it
## Comes out again if
The condition under which we delete this. Written now,
while we still remember why we built it.
